items.title: Jack Kelly Interview, 1963-11-17
items.q: Now I go for Jeff's style and I think Jeff got plenty of the problem. Jeff's about the closest down here.

ctx.x: So you wouldn't say Howard sounds much like him now?

Not since he lost his lip. He used to. Now when he first started, he did. He was a dead image of him. Yeah. Yeah. I would play everything just like my dad. But since he lost his lip, he got a lot of difference. Now I go for Jeff's style and I think Jeff got plenty of the problem. Jeff's about the closest down here. Now?
